review_type: purposeful narrative selection; not a systematic review

papers.title: Therapeutic serum level for adalimumab in rheumatoid arthritis: explorative analyses of data from a randomised phase III trial
papers.study_design: Post hoc longitudinal concentration-outcome analysis of a 48-week randomised phase III biosimilarity trial (ADMYRA); not a randomised trial of concentration-guided dosing
endpoints: DAS28-ESR remission and low disease activity
CRP concentration
Longitudinal serum adalimumab trough concentration

findings.crp_association: Lower CRP at trough concentrations at or above 3.9 mg/L
findings.interpretation: The approximately 4 mg/L proposal is population-specific association evidence, not a universal threshold or demonstrated benefit of dosing intervention.

data_availability.access: Data available from Sandoz upon reasonable request

evidence_limits: Post hoc concentration-response associations are not randomised exposure comparisons
Stringent trial inclusion criteria limit external validity
All participants received methotrexate; cannot isolate its influence on drug levels or immunogenicity
Selected continuation after week 24 and changing denominators require care
Does not establish thresholds for psoriasis, AS or lupus
No TOP2A, RNA expression or patient-specific binding geometry endpoint; does not complete the indirect mechanistic bridge

papers.summary_fa: در تحلیل ثانویهٔ داده‌های ۴۸هفته‌ای کارآزمایی ADMYRA، غلظت سرمی بیشتر آدالیموماب با فعالیت کمتر بیماری و CRP کمتر همراه بود. همهٔ بیماران متوترکسات همراه دریافت می‌کردند.
papers.critique_fa: ارتباط آماری، اثر تنظیم دوز را ثابت نمی‌کند؛ این تحلیل شکل اتصال در هر بیمار را اندازه نگرفته است. دادهٔ فردی عمومی نیست و آستانهٔ پژوهش، توصیهٔ درمان عمومی محسوب نمی‌شود.

evidence_pointers: PubMed and Europe PMC publication date/DOI
Methods: post hoc ADMYRA analysis and concomitant methotrexate
Results: longitudinal sample denominators and CRP association
Data availability: nonpublic Sandoz data upon request

papers.summary_fa: نویسندگان از قالب‌های بلوری، مدل آنتی‌بادی کامل ساختند و حالت‌های اتصال و قندگذاری را شبیه‌سازی کردند. در مدل‌ها، اتصال به آنتی‌ژن با تغییر شکل و هم‌حرکتی بخش‌های آنتی‌بادی و دسترسی سطح Fc همراه بود.

papers.study_design: Chimeric full-IgG homology modelling and accelerated molecular dynamics; no new patient efficacy study or experimentally solved full-adalimumab structure

papers.title: Enhancement of activation-induced T cell proliferation by SIRPG in a CD47-independent manner
papers.project_role_fa: برای مرحلهٔ بعد: آزمایش‌های جدا دربارهٔ SIRPG و TOP2A
papers.rationale_fa: دو مداخلهٔ مشخص دارد: اثر آدالیموماب بر SIRPG و اثر حذف SIRPG بر TOP2A/تکثیر. برای ساختن پرسش واسطهٔ سلولی مفید است؛ مسیر کامل یا جهت اثر دارو را اثبات نمی‌کند.
papers.summary_fa: آدالیموماب در سلول T فعال‌شدهٔ اهداکنندهٔ سالم، SIRPG سطحی را افزایش داد. در آزمایش جدا، حذف SIRPG با کاهش RNA ژن TOP2A و ژن‌های چرخه و تکثیر همراه بود؛ qPCR نیز گزارش شد.
papers.critique_fa: افزایش SIRPG با دارو و کاهش TOP2A با حذف SIRPG، دو آزمایش جدا هستند؛ اثر دارو بر TOP2A یا میانجی‌گری اثبات نشده است. دادهٔ RNA گروه آدالیموماب ندارد و سلول سالم فعال‌شده، بیمار RA نیست.
papers.study_design: Human T-cell pharmacological stimulation and separate CRISPR SIRPG loss-of-function experiments, bulk RNA-seq, independent-donor qPCR and proliferation assays; not a clinical adalimumab efficacy or ADA-to-TOP2A mediation trial

cohort.adalimumab_experiment: Activated peripheral T cells from healthy donors; resting unstimulated cells studied as a context comparator
cohort.synovial_fluid_diagnosis_as_reported: inflammatory arthritis; not asserted to be a uniform RA cohort
cohort.Jurkat_cell_line: Used in separate knockout/rescue/domain experiments; a leukaemia-derived line is not clinical cancer evidence
cohort.sample_count_interpretation: GEO library counts are not independent patient counts; article reports a poor-quality CD8 pair excluded in its described analysis. The entire 46-record series is not automatically the selected day-4 analysis cohort.

methods.drug_experiment_evidence_pointer: Results: Differential effects of TNF-alpha inhibitors on the expression of SIRPG; Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure S2
methods.RNAseq_experiment: WT and SIRPG knockout cells were mixed 1:1 per donor, restimulated with anti-CD3/IL-2, sorted by SIRPG and CD4/CD8, and compared in a separate perturbation experiment
methods.TOP2A_evidence_pointer: Figure 3D-F: pooled cell-cycle genes and independent-donor qPCR; Figure 4: proliferation and Ki67

endpoints: Surface SIRPG by flow cytometry after T-cell activation with/without TNF inhibitors
RNA abundance after SIRPG deletion, including TOP2A and other cell-cycle genes
T-cell proliferation and Ki67 in the SIRPG perturbation experiments

findings.adalimumab_to_SIRPG: Increase in activated healthy-donor T cells; not increased in unstimulated resting T cells
findings.SIRPG_knockout_to_TOP2A: Lower TOP2A RNA and cell-cycle expression in a separate knockout experiment; qPCR confirmation reported
findings.adalimumab_to_TOP2A_direction: Undetermined: cannot infer increase, decrease or no change from composing two separate experiments

data_availability.series_design: Healthy-donor PBMC derivatives; CRISPR SIRPG WT/KO; activated for editing, rested/maintained in IL-2 and restimulated; sorted CD4/CD8 on days 2 and 4
data_availability.license: No dataset-specific licence assertion made; public repository access is verified

evidence_limits: Pharmacological ADA-to-SIRPG and genetic SIRPG-to-TOP2A results come from separate experiments; they do not establish a completed causal mediation pathway
Direction of any ADA-to-TOP2A effect remains untested and must not be labelled suppression
Healthy-donor activated T cells, inflammatory-arthritis synovial fluid and Jurkat rescue models are different systems
Comparison of molecules with and without Fc is not an isolated experimental proof of an Fc mechanism
RNA abundance after a knockout is not a TOP2A atomic structure or direct antibody-target binding measurement
GEO has no adalimumab arm; it cannot estimate drug effects on TOP2A
Donor, library, sorted subset and timepoint counts must not be treated as interchangeable units

evidence_pointers: Publisher header/editor-reviewers and Crossref online date
Results Figure 2 and unstimulated-cell comparator Figure 2F
Results Figure 3: six donors, excluded poor-quality pair, pooled DEGs and independent qPCR
Methods/Data availability and live GSE296196 sample treatment, genotype, subset and time labels

project_evidence_limits: The project does not reproduce published MD, wet-lab, RNA-seq or clinical results; the local coordinate/contact analysis has its own limited scope
Verified bibliography or peer review does not independently validate every scientific conclusion
ADA directly targets TNF; direct TOP2A binding, suppression or anticancer efficacy is not established by these sources
Marguerie ADA-to-SIRPG increase and SIRPG-knockout-to-TOP2A decrease are separate experiments; direction and causal mediation for ADA-to-TOP2A are undetermined
GSE296196 has no adalimumab treatment arm; its WT/KO RNA libraries do not measure response to adalimumab
Shi uses SW982 and A549 cancer-derived models and PluriSIn #2; do not reinterpret its intervention as adalimumab or its models as RA/cancer patient proof
Modelled full IgG coordinates are not experimental full-adalimumab crystal structures
Ubah VNAR binders are mechanistic comparators, not adalimumab or an established superior RA therapy
CRP/concentration associations do not measure molecular geometry or justify dosing decisions
Reference mRNA/protein sequences are not RNA abundance measurements, patient variants or a solved RNA fold
Old direct experimental foundations remain required and are not counted among the three recent reviews
No copyrighted full text or identifying clinical records are committed in this metadata file
selection_basis: Current user-confirmed order is RA, adalimumab/TNF mechanism and data literacy; learn codons and TOP2A in parallel, then choose an evidence-supported advanced question. Hu 2013, Gehin 2024 and Tao 2021 serve different foundational roles; recency alone does not determine the teaching order.
